import re

def extract_paid(body):
    # look for patterns like 'You have paid => $626'
    m=re.search(r'(?i)you have paid\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2})', body)
    if m: return float(m.group(1).replace(',',''))
    m=re.search(r'(?i)you have paid\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9,]+)', body)
    if m: return float(m.group(1).replace(',',''))
    # other possible: 'Paid: $123.45'
    m=re.search(r'(?i)paid\s*[:=]\s*\$\s*([0-9,]+\.[0-9]{2})', body)
    if m: return float(m.group(1).replace(',',''))
    return None

def extract_last4(body):
    # find 'Card ending in => 5342'
    m=re.search(r'(?i)card ending in\s*=>\s*([0-9]{4})', body)
    if m: return m.group(1)
    m=re.search(r'(?i)ending in\s*([0-9]{4})', body)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
